cases.description: Explorer count of Doors in the Architectural link (main model and primary design options)
manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt' in Revit 2026 with the 'Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural' link loaded, and open the Model Context panel.
Choose Scope 'Whole model' and check the 'Architectural' link in the document list.
On the Explorer tab expand the Architectural link row: the Doors row shows 142.

Check without the panel: open 'Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural.rvt' (do not save), create a Doors schedule with 'Itemize every instance' on and Grand totals > Count; the total is 142 when every secondary design option is excluded (Visibility/Graphics > Design Options: each option set shows its primary).

cases.description: Explorer count of Walls in the Architectural link (main model and primary design options)
manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt' in Revit 2026 with the 'Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural' link loaded, and open the Model Context panel.
Choose Scope 'Whole model' and check the 'Architectural' link in the document list.
On the Explorer tab expand the Architectural link row: the Walls row shows 1,120.

Check without the panel: open 'Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural.rvt' (do not save), create a Walls schedule with 'Itemize every instance' on and Grand totals > Count; walls in secondary design options are not counted.

cases.description: Explorer count of Ducts in the Current model
manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt' in Revit 2026 and open the Model Context panel.
Choose Scope 'Whole model' and check 'Current model' in the document list.
On the Explorer tab expand 'Current model': the Ducts row shows 1,053.
Check without the panel: create a Duct schedule (do not save) with 'Itemize every instance' on and Grand totals > Count; the total is 1,053.

cases.description: Snapshot rows per category equal the oracle's plain collector count, for the Current model and the Architectural link
cases.expected: equal to the oracle for every category
manualSteps: Open the sample with the Architectural link and the Model Context panel; Scope 'Whole model'.
On the Explorer tab expand 'Current model' and then the Architectural link; note each category count.
Pick any three categories and compare with a schedule of that category in the matching file (Grand totals > Count, do not save).

cases.description: Quick counts (shown before the full snapshot loads) equal the oracle per category
cases.expected: equal to the oracle for every category
manualSteps: Open the sample with the Architectural link and the Model Context panel; Scope 'Whole model'.
Check a document: the Explorer counts appear at once and must not change when loading finishes.

cases.description: Active view counts per category equal the view collector of view L3 (link elements through the host view)
cases.expected: equal to the oracle for every category
manualSteps: Make floor plan 'L3' the active view and choose Scope 'Active view' in the panel.
On the Explorer tab note the Current model category counts.
In view L3 drag a selection window over the whole plan and click Filter (Modify tab): the per-category counts of the Current model match the Explorer.

cases.description: Active view element ids equal the view collector of view L3
cases.expected: the same id set as the oracle
manualSteps: Make floor plan 'L3' the active view and choose Scope 'Active view' in the panel.
On the Filter tab make a filter with no rules and Categories Ducts, then use the result row menu > Select: Revit selects exactly the ducts shown in L3.

cases.description: Secondary design options stay out of Whole model counts: the snapshot holds main model and primary option elements only
cases.expected: snapshot count = oracle main + primary count
manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample Architectural.rvt' (do not save) and open Manage > Design Options to see the option sets and their primary options.
In the HVAC model with the panel, Scope 'Whole model', check the Architectural link: Walls shows 1,120, which excludes walls in secondary options.

cases.description: The document list holds the Current model first, then each loaded link
cases.expected: the same documents as the model's loaded link instances, Current model first
manualSteps: Open 'Snowdon Towers Sample HVAC.rvt' with its links loaded and open the Model Context panel.
The document list starts with 'Current model' and then lists each loaded link (compare with Manage > Manage Links).
